title: These Models Make Money with Hands, Feet
main_content:
Gisele Bundchen, Cindy Crawford and Kate Moss are some of the super-models of the fashion world.

But there are other highly paid models whose faces you’ve never seen.

These people work in “body parts modeling,” a specialized area of the modeling business. You have probably seen their beautiful hands, feet or  earlobes in advertisements for gloves, designer shoes or earrings.

Hands, feet and legs are the most requested body parts for both male and female models.

It is quite a profitable business.

Forbes.com reported that top parts-models earn around $1,000 per day for TV commercials, and between $2,000 to $5,000 a day for print work. A female parts-model with great legs and feet can earn about $75,000 a year.

As with super-models in the fashion world, there are top-of-the-line parts models who get high fees. An example is Ellen Sirot, one of the highest-paid hand and foot models in the U.S.

questions.question: What is “body parts modeling”?
options: A modeling sector focusing on full body representations.
A specialized area of modeling that features individual body parts in advertisements.
An exclusive fashion show for high-end clothing brands.
A type of modeling that primarily showcases facial expressions.
questions.answer: A specialized area of modeling that features individual body parts in advertisements.

questions.question: Who is Ellen Sirot?
options: A renowned fashion designer known for her shoe collections.
One of the highest-paid hand and foot models in the U.S.
A famous super-model celebrated for her runway work.
A magazine editor specializing in beauty and fashion.
questions.answer: One of the highest-paid hand and foot models in the U.S.
